amem.note: MedMemoryBench vendored A-MEM source via add_note/find_related_memories; retrieval-only output is passed to the shared HABIT answerer.

full_history.note: Backward-compatible alias of full_memory: capacity-aware window tiers, all visible history if it fits, otherwise recent complete sessions.

full_memory.note: Capacity-aware long-context control with auto/8k/16k/32k/40k/64k/128k/custom tiers and recent-session truncation on overflow.

letta.note: MedMemoryBench vendored Letta source; archival passage retrieval is exposed without a Letta answer turn.

lightmem.note: MedMemoryBench LightMem source with the recorded compatibility patch; native retrieve output is passed to the shared HABIT answerer.

mem0.note: MedMemoryBench vendored Mem0 source via Memory.add/Memory.search; no external hosted memory workflow or method-specific answer call.

memos.note: MedMemoryBench MemOS source; native text-memory search is exposed without reader generation.

memrl.note: MedMemoryBench MemRL source; value-aware selected memories are exposed without reader generation.

mirix.note: MedMemoryBench MIRIX source; multi-store retrieval is exposed without native send_message answering.

no_memory.note: Qwen3-8B receives only the current request and choices; not a learned memory method.

secom.note: Official segmentation, LLMLingua compression and FAISS retrieval adapted to chronological online session ingestion.
